mac.text: A MacBook Pro (M1 Max) and a Ryzen 9 desktop called mars are joined by a wired 10 gigabit Ethernet link. Right now it tests whether xs, given a larger parent-descriptor budget, pulls psample onto the Mac faster than its parent version and rsync.

mars.text: This pair links neo, a Raspberry Pi 5 with 4 GB of memory and an NVMe drive, to mars, a 12-core Ryzen 9 desktop with 32 GB of memory, over a wired gigabit connection. It is idle right now, with no experiment running.

neo.text: Neo, a Raspberry Pi 5, is connected to mars, a macOS desktop, over a wired gigabit LAN link. The experiment is idle, so no transfer test is running right now.

neo-ssd.text: Neo, a Raspberry Pi 5 with an NVMe drive, copies over a local SSD link to a T5. It is testing whether limiting neo to 2 CPUs widens the gap between xs -a -j4 and rsync -a on a fresh cold copy of real-psample.
